flashcard_questions.q: A long-term shift in global temperatures and weather patterns, occurring both naturally and as a result of human activity.
A cold period when global temperatures drop and ice sheets expand across large areas of the Earth.
A warmer period between glacials when temperatures rise and ice retreats, like the present day.

flashcard_questions.a: The most recent geological period, spanning the last 2.5 million years, characterised by repeated cycles of glaciation.
An oval-shaped orbit, meaning the Earth is sometimes closer to and sometimes further from the sun.
